scope: post-development instrument only; no quality eligibility is conferred until future captures satisfy every rule

behavioral_reference_pair.classification: frozen behavioral-reference eligibility pair, not causal quantization-only comparison
behavioral_reference_pair.causal_quantization_derivation: not retained; must not be asserted

access_control.awq_holdout_access: forbidden until all three BF16 captures and sequence-specific ceiling artifact validate

control_rules.nll_ceiling: for every sealed sequence, 1.05 * max(mean BF16 NLL across three captures)

candidate_rules.critical_category_regression: reject when candidate point score minus BF16 point score is less than -1/6

paired_bootstrap.statistic: equal-weight mean of category-stratified paired score deltas

candidate_rules.nll: reject any candidate NLL above its sequence-specific frozen BF16 ceiling
